name: Analog Drive
description: Five circuits to push a sound through (tape preamp, console, transformer, triode, pentode), from weight and glue to a folded-over fuzz, with the loudness held while you turn it up.

params.name: Drive
params.description: How hard the sound hits the circuit. Low settings add weight and hold the peaks; further up it compresses, thickens and finally squares off.

params.name: Circuit
params.description: What is being overdriven. Tape preamp is soft and dulls loud highs, Console is brighter with a firm edge, Transformer thickens and breaks up the lows first, Triode is smooth and lopsided, Pentode stays clean and then bites.

params.name: Push
params.description: Sends the sound into the circuit far hotter, past anything Drive reaches alone, with the level brought back down after it. This is the setting that goes too far.

params.name: Low Cut
params.description: Takes the lows out before the circuit, so the bass stops driving it and the distortion gets tighter and thinner. At the bottom it is out of the path.

params.name: Thump
params.description: A resonant bump in the lows just above the Low Cut, going into the circuit, so that part of the sound is what breaks up.

params.name: Tone
params.description: Tilts the driven sound after the circuit. Down is darker and fuller, up is brighter and leaner.

params.name: High Cut
params.description: A steep filter after the circuit that takes the fizz off the top of the driven sound. At the top it is out of the path.

params.name: Auto Gain
params.description: On, the loudness stays about where it was while Drive changes the character. Off, Drive also makes it louder, up to the circuit's ceiling.

params.name: Output
params.description: Level of the driven sound. The clean part of Mix is not affected.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the clean sound and the driven one. Part way keeps the clean attack and lays the grit under it.
